prompts.catalog: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: first-phase MR app model CONCEPT contact sheet, not finished 3D assets. Generate a high resolution landscape 3-row by 5-column studio contact sheet, exactly fifteen separate hero objects, one per evenly spaced cell, all fully visible with generous padding. NO TEXT anywhere, no labels, no watermarks. Neutral soft light gray studio background, realistic PBR industrial design, consistent 3/4 perspective, soft contact shadows, no stylization, no logos or brands. Top row GLASS exactly left to right: (1) clear drinking tumbler (2) dark green empty red wine bottle with no label (3) transparent wide mouth storage jar with simple lid (4) frosted bell shaped chandelier glass shade only, no cables (5) small amber perfume bottle with metal cap. Middle row CERAMIC left to right: (6) ivory ceramic dinner plate slightly tilted to show rim (7) blue gray porcelain bowl (8) tall off-white vase (9) rust-orange ceramic mug with handle (10) small abstract ivory ceramic knot sculpture. Bottom row ELECTRONICS / PLASTIC left to right: (11) old full black keyboard (12) old black smartphone, screen off (13) old dark remote control (14) small older thick bezel LCD computer monitor including stand, screen off (15) smoke translucent plastic storage box with lid. Used objects with subtle wear, intact. Each object clearly distinct from its neighbor. Pure product concept sheet for a photorealistic mixed reality stress relief app.
prompts.fracture: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: first-phase photorealistic MR physics visual design storyboard, not a real device screenshot. Wide landscape 3-panel storyboard all on consistent neutral residential setting, no text, no UI, no logos. Photorealistic modern quiet living room with pale timber floor, off white walls and soft afternoon window light. Panel 1 left: closeup of a transparent drinking glass in mid air just above the real wooden floor, realistic motion blur on glass only. Panel 2 middle: same glass at the precise first floor impact, geometry splitting into physically plausible curved thin glass shards with cut faces, scattering along impact direction; absolutely no glowing light, no magical sparkles, no explosion, no smoke. Panel 3 right: low viewpoint of the settled broken clear glass shards on same wooden floor, convincing contact shadows and refraction, some larger fragments and tiny secondary chips, no disappearance. Three equally sized compositions separated by narrow neutral gutters. Glass and floor must feel completely real. Convey tactile release and weight, understated realistic MR concept. No human injury, no humans required.
